Ideal for educational projects, astronomical research, or creating unique decor, this model allows you to delve into the fascinating world of space exploration. Dive into the amazing world of the Moon with our Copernicus crater 3D model today!

Copernicus Crater is a medium-sized impact lunar crater named after the Polish astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus. It is located in the eastern part of the Ocean of Storms. The crater is about 800 million years old, meaning it was formed during the Copernican period of the Moon's geologic history. Due to its small age it has good preservation and clear structures. The depth of the crater is 3800 meters. The diameter of the crater is 96 km.
